summary: New box Preterit: example for sense 1 in Preterit (104/38)

data.turoyo: W maltamle zlame, d kətwayne rešone w d kətwayne ann abne dam malke w d kətwayne ann abne daš šyux w maḥtile ʕal aw waḏ̣ayəf w mratable i dawlayḏe.
data.translation: Dann suchte er edle, vornehme Männer zusammen, Söhne von Königen, Söhne von Scheichen, setzte sie in die Beamtenstellen ein und ordnete sein reich aufs Neue.

rationale: First Preterit box; explicit state object and appointment context exemplify arranging an institution.

summary: 26/202 is already the sole Imperativ quotation; the reader's thin-cell add request would duplicate it.
104/38 supplies the inherited base mratable as an actual Preterit attestation, not a new stem. Its state object is zero-marked.
Reflexive ruḥayxu at26/202 uses active II morphology. The institutional object at104/38 is ordinary verbal valency, not sufficient reason for a light verb idiom.

Does institutional rtb specifically imply reorganization of something already established? The edition says aufs Neue, but the Turoyo has no separate again expression; the entry should not encode that implication from German alone.
A state can be arranged/reorganized, alongside people setting up their household; same ordering/setting-up meaning.
